svg.text: End-to-end architecture · two independent ML detectors + rule-based risk engine

g.text: Submit an email to detect spam and
Quarantine and do not click any links.
HAM + PHISHING — the case a spam filter alone misses
The two classifiers are independent. HAM does not imply LEGITIMATE, and
SPAM does not imply PHISHING. All four combinations are represented.
Pydantic validation · 20,000 char limit · CORS allow-list · no stack traces leaked
Answers: is this unwanted bulk mail?
Answers: is this trying to deceive?
Deterministic lookup over the two boolean verdicts. No probability, no training.
